description: Creates or updates a Salesforce Approval Process via the Metadata API. Define who can submit, approval steps with approvers, entry criteria, and what happens on approval or rejection.

active.description: Activate immediately (warning: cannot change steps after activation)

allowRecall.description: Allow submitters to recall approval requests

submitter.description: API name or username (required for role/group/user types)

name.description: API name or username (not needed for adhoc/userHierarchyField)

entryFormula.description: Formula that must be true for this step to apply

ifCriteriaNotMet.description: What to do when entry formula is false

name.description: API name of the step, e.g. 'Manager_Approval'

whenMultiple.description: 'Unanimous' = all must approve, 'FirstResponse' = first response wins

emailTemplate.description: Email template for approval notifications, e.g. 'unfiled$public/ApprovalEmail'

entryFormula.description: Formula records must satisfy to enter this process

label.description: Human-readable label, e.g. 'Large Deal Approval Process'

processName.description: API name of the process, e.g. 'Large_Deal_Approval'

recordEditability.description: Who can edit locked records during approval

name: sf_create_approval_process
title: Create Salesforce Approval Process
